end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Correctly used place-value zeros and expanded forms in 3 of 3 attempts.
Still joined spoken number parts incorrectly in one example, such as “four thousand fifty.”
The tens-place confusion in 8614 and 3208 was not fully corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value columns, especially how zeros hold an empty place, and Diya correctly worked through numbers such as 6007 and 7040 with expanded forms. Diya mixed up how spoken parts such as “four thousand fifty” map to digits, and the tens-place confusion was still present at the end. At home, say a 4-digit number aloud and have Diya fill a thousands-hundreds-tens-ones table before writing the numeral; check each digit by place.
